execution_assumptions: Graph sizes may grow beyond the regression inputs, which only check classical semantics.
Edge weights are classical input data and their encoding cost must be stated.
The API requires the exact optimum; no approximation permission is given.
input_domain: n >= 0; edges are (u,v,nonnegative_integer_weight) with 0 <= u,v < n; self loops contribute zero; repeated edges count separately.
software_contract: Return the exact maximum total weight crossing a binary partition.
title: Graph interface
